rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available and avoided assigning a specific morphology grade. It mentioned only general blastocyst concepts rather than fabricating visible features, so despite not analyzing the actual embryo image, it remained morphologically cautious and largely accurate.

It integrated age, ovarian response, AMH/FSH, tubal factor, endometrial thickness, prior IVF failure, BMI, stress, and sperm parameters into prognosis reasonably well, though some links to embryo-specific quality were somewhat generic.

The response is structured and mostly logical, but some probability adjustments are subjective and not strongly evidence-based, especially the quantified effects of stress, MII yield, and prior failure on implantation.

Much of the discussion is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but recommending PGT-A as 'strongly recommended' at age 33 after a single failed cycle, suggesting ERA after limited failure, and proposing aspirin/anxiolytics are more aggressive than guideline-based routine care.

It provides clear next steps for transfer support and contingency planning, including luteal support review and further workup if unsuccessful. Some recommendations are practical, though a few are not sufficiently individualized or evidence-anchored.
